caption: First session: searching the component library for "MyLab" finds nothing and PDK Management lists only the bundled PDKs — no user PDK is loaded yet.
The user imports "MyLab User PDK" via Tools → Load PDK…: its three components appear in the library and the PDK is listed under PDK Management as 📂 User.

After an app restart the PDK path recorded in preferences is reloaded at startup, so the user PDK and its components are back without re-importing (the fix for issue #700 — previously this view was empty again).
